doc_friction.issue: run_workflow_locally.py --for-changes ran past the 120 s tool timeout on a docs-and-story diff (it runs devsec-toolkit-ci and others); it has to go in the background even for a text-only change.

'pick the project that has gone longest' compares projects by git log, but the For Other Minds and Little Lamps shelves live inside hearth-and-horizon, so the log alone can't show which shelf is starved; I counted the shelves by front matter (274 / 34 / 16) instead.

deviations.did: Landed the text and pages without audio, and skipped the podcast option, as the prompt says

notes: Project: Hearth & Horizon, For Other Minds shelf (the smallest, 16 stories). Piece: the-hour-that-happens-twice (about 3,100 words, text only). I picked a theme no shelf story had covered yet (clock change / DST ambiguity in scheduling), after grepping for it. I checked the Python behaviours the story relies on: a same-zone subtraction gives 1 day while the UTC subtraction gives 1 day 1 h, and fold=0 resolves 01:00 to 00:00 UTC. node --test in hearth-and-horizon passes 12 of 12. The security queue was empty, IDEAS.md had nothing pending and there were no open website requests. No agent doc: nothing new that the next run needs beyond the BIBLE entry.

pricing.source: Anthropic pricing as cached in the Claude API skill (models table and per-model migration notes), 2026-10-06. Cache writes are 1.25x input (5-minute) and 2x input (1-hour); cache reads differ by model.

human_equivalent.basis: a professional writer drafting and fact-checking a 3,000-word technical short story plus a blog post

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id
certainty.model: high: the `model` field on each API response, not the configured model
certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured

not_counted: requests the harness makes outside the transcript (context compaction summaries, title generation, safety classifiers), if any
transcripts lost when a cloud session moved to a new container: only files present in this container are read, so a resumed session can undercount
server-tool fees (web search is billed per search, not per token); the count is recorded, not priced
